Partners Group Holding Ag Cut Williams Cos Inc/The (WMB) Stake as Stock Declined; Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Share Value Declined While Dubuque Bank & Trust Company Has Lifted Its Holding
June 8, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Partners Group Holding Ag decreased its stake in Williams Cos Inc/The (WMB) by 9.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Partners Group Holding Ag sold 47,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.00% with the market. The institutional investor held 440,700 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $10.96 million, down from 488,200 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Partners Group Holding Ag who had been investing in Williams Cos Inc/The for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $21.52 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.57% or $0.41 during the last trading session, reaching $26. About 1.27 million shares traded. The Williams Companies, Inc. (NYSE:WMB) has declined 9.61% since June 8, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.18% the S&P500.
